claim: Any fundamental change seems to start with every single day
You are what you do daily, not three times a week, not for two weeks and then stop
What you do every single day for weeks and months literally becomes who you are, not the special events
To change, improve, add or even subtract something, it's got to be every day
Any attempt to get in shape, eat better or improve a relationship not focused on every day seems destined to fail
What you do every single day, not twice a week or twice a month, compounds really powerfully. That's how tremendous changes happen
What you do every single day works against you as much as for you

Early in adulthood, absolutely miserable, the daily eating was something like a 7-Eleven hot dog with chili for breakfast and fast food for lunch and on the way home. For a while, almost nightly, literally every single day, came McDonald's and a Taco Bell caramel apple empanada, "this frozen taco thing from hell", with ice cream and caramel syrup added. No Taco Bell in many years now, thank goodness. The result: a disaster zone, physically and mentally
For the most part we seem to want to add things: habits, routines, powers, skills, knowledge, experiences. So it seems fundamental to look at what you do every single day
The podcast is daily to help you feel better and more powerful every day, not occasionally, since every day becomes who you are and the life you experience
The podcast is daily because, personally, to dramatically impact your life and as many other lives as possible, what is done every single day has to shift
Whatever you want to change, start with every single day, and don't make it negotiable
To get in shape, work out every single day: not the same thing, not crushing yourself nonstop, some days active recovery or whatever
For a change you want, not three times a week, not a plan, but: "this hasn't been a part of every single day who I am. But going forward, it's gonna be a part of every single day who I am"
Made every day, what you want to change becomes who you are instead of something that you do, from working out, eating and your relationship to being a father, your kids, your business, your health
Personally, nothing in life is more important than being a father
Made every day, communicating with your spouse, or caring for your body, goes from a few times a week to part of who you are
When what you do every day becomes who you are, the really powerful changes happen: you look back and see how dramatically different that part of life used to be
From experience, personally, what leads to the really powerful changes is every day

To change something, not "hey honey, we should sit down once a week and talk", not three workouts this week, not attention to your kids two days this week because stress lets you focus only on those two. Not three, two or five times a week. Make it every day, non-negotiable, and you will see tremendous change and impact
